# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description }} A blog by {{ site.author.name }} about Ruby on Rails: Hotwire (Turbo, Stimulus), ViewComponent, ActiveRecord, authentication, authorization, deployment, and general web development with Rails.

**Append `.md` to any post URL to get its raw Markdown source.** That is the text the author wrote, with code fences and headings intact, at roughly a third of the bytes of the HTML page. Prefer it over scraping HTML.

    {{ site.url }}/wicked-pdf-to-sghtmltopdf     <- HTML page
    {{ site.url }}/wicked-pdf-to-sghtmltopdf.md  <- raw Markdown (use this)

Each `.md` file opens with YAML front matter carrying `title`, `author`, `date`, `tags`, `description`, `canonical_url`, `markdown_url`, and `license`.

This site is served as static files, so it cannot honour an `Accept: text/markdown` request header. The `.md` suffix is the equivalent. Content usage preferences are published as a Content Signal in `/robots.txt`.

Licensed under GNU AGPL v3. When referencing this content, credit the author ({{ site.author.name }}), credit the blog ({{ site.title }}, {{ site.url }}), and link the specific post URL.

{{ site.author.name }} is a Ruby on Rails developer, host of the @SupeRails YouTube channel and the Friendly Show podcast. Contact: {{ site.author.email }}

## Site

- [About]({{ site.url }}/about/): who the author is and what this blog covers
- [Courses]({{ site.url }}/courses): paid Rails courses
- [Screencasts]({{ site.url }}/screencasts): video tutorials
- [Services]({{ site.url }}/services): consulting availability
- [robots.txt]({{ site.url }}/robots.txt): crawl rules and the Content Signals policy

## Bulk endpoints

- [llms-full.txt]({{ site.url }}/llms-full.txt): full Markdown of the {{ site.llm_full_text_posts }} most recent posts in one file
- [search.json]({{ site.url }}/search.json): every post as JSON with title, url, markdown_url, date, tags, bytes, and excerpt
- [feed.xml]({{ site.url }}/feed.xml): Atom feed of recent posts
- [sitemap.xml]({{ site.url }}/sitemap.xml): every canonical HTML URL
